svg.title: Nothing runs until asked
svg.desc: A source, a filter and a mapper are algorithms, each one's input connected to the output port of the one before; the mapper's actor, its renderer and the render window follow. Output flows downstream, but only when Update() on an algorithm, or Render() on the window, sends a request upstream; each algorithm then runs only if it, or one before it, changed since its last run.

g.text: each runs only if it, or one before it,
